subject: Reference request: EdgeAI deployment — peer sync with CSO
messages:
From: Maya Desai <maya@edgeai.tech>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: peer we can speak with about distributed inference/edge latency

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — it was helpful to see Redwood's routing and KV cache behavior. We're in late-stage procurement for a gateway-scale EdgeAI pilot and the CSO and architecture leads at Telaxis want to speak with a peer who has run a similar deployment at scale (security posture + multi-region latency top of mind).

Can you connect us to someone who is comfortable talking at the executive/security level (CSO or Head of Infra) and can also speak to operational lessons (autoscaling, fallbacks, quantization tradeoffs)? We have legal reviews in parallel but we want the peer call before finalizing the SOW.

Timeline: ideally next week (Jun 8–10) for a 30-minute sync. POC target: Q3 pilot across 2000 gateways.

Happy to sign an NDA if needed.

Thanks,
Maya Desai
VP Partnerships, EdgeAI.Tech
maya@edgeai.tech
(415) 555-0127
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Desai <maya@edgeai.tech>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: peer we can speak with about distributed inference/edge latency

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely arrange a short peer sync.

Options:
- I can introduce you to Alicia Gomez at Skyline (they ran an EdgeAI inference fleet last year and are comfortable talking CSO-level tradeoffs).
- If you prefer a purely security/architecture conversation, we can loop in a product-ops exec who ran multi-region rollouts.

I attached a short reference Q&A sheet so you know what to expect on the call and a network diagram stub you can share with your security team (telaxis-arc-arch-diagram.pdf). Please confirm whether the exec-level perspective is preferred and which date window works for you.

Also: quick question on confidentiality — will Telaxis share a sanitized architecture diagram in advance or do you want us to keep the call high-level? If you want an NDA first, I can route it to Legal.

Proposed times (PST): Tue 8th 10:00–10:30, Wed 9th 14:00–14:30, Thu 10th 09:00–09:30.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-reference-qa-sheet.docx (draft), telaxis-arc-arch-diagram.pdf (context)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Maya Desai <maya@edgeai.tech>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@telaxis.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: peer we can speak with about distributed inference/edge latency

Hi all — looping in Alicia Gomez from Skyline (cc'd) as the proposed reference. Alicia, Skyline recently completed a 6-month pilot deploying decentralized inference on gateway hardware; they can speak to security reviews, latency SLAs, and how they used Redwood's autoscaling/fallbacks to maintain availability.

Alicia — could you do a 30-minute intro with Maya and Carlos next week? Proposed slots: Tue 8 10:00–10:30 or Wed 9 14:00–14:30 (PST). If you need, Vanessa or I will run a short agenda: 1) high-level architecture; 2) security & compliance lessons; 3) ops handoff & SLOs.

For Telaxis: we added a one-page architecture diagram to the shared Drive; that should help your security reviewers.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer References | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: telaxis-arc-arch-diagram.pdf (sent for context)
From: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@telaxis.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Maya Desai <maya@edgeai.tech>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@skyline.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: peer we can speak with about distributed inference/edge latency

Perfect — thanks everyone. Tue 8 at 10:00 PST works for our CSO and the procurement lead; we'll join the 30-minute slot.

Alicia, looking forward to hearing about your security testing and how you handled rolling upgrades across thousands of gateways. We will keep the discussion at a high-level; Legal will follow up about the NDA but it shouldn't block the intro.

See you Tuesday.

—Carlos
